summary: Convert aggregate campaign observations into falsifiable creative variants, precommitted metrics, guardrails, and a controlled experiment decision.
triggers: Aggregate campaign evidence needs a bounded creative hypothesis.
Paid-creative variants require a precommitted comparison and stopping rule.
A launch packet must separate observed signals from unverified audience or performance claims.
antiTriggers: Launch ads, spend, or change targeting without explicit task scope.
Infer sensitive traits or unsupported audience intent.
Call an authored preview or fixture real campaign performance.

provenance.note: Method source read in full and independently rewritten for portable product use; the historical file remains unchanged.
Aggregate evidence, variant, guardrail, measurement, launch-gate, and failure semantics informed the rewrite; no source prose was copied.
Ownership and evidence boundaries were consulted; no campaign performance or launch result is asserted.
